title: Setup → Audit Logs: the row drawer has no way to open the audit row's record page, which lists the other changes to the same record
body:
domain:server#5 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4cyvF7SP65frVFAYLv7

Filing gate: ① the ui half of #30209 row 4 B, named by the seat in its ACCEPT on PR #30728 (comment 6672516987, "Out of scope / follow-up"); the server half landed in PR #30728 (merge commit `05a30e6e`). ⛔ Not a claim. Suggested grade: p3.
Dedupe: `sys_audit_log_detail`, `AuditLogPage drawer record page`, `other changes to the same record` — no open card. **New.**
Reader: the `ui/**` lane (`ui/apps/console/src/pages/system/AuditLogPage.tsx`).

## What happens

Since PR #30728, `sys_audit_log` has a default record page (`sys_audit_log_detail`, `plugin-audit`) that lists every other ledger row with the same `record_id`, newest first. Beside a settings write's `config_change` row (which carries only a digest) that list holds the CRUD mirror's create/update rows for the same settings row, so the administrator can read what the value was changed to; `config_change` rows now carry `record_id` = the settings row id for this to work.

Setup → Audit Logs (`AuditLogPage.tsx`) is a custom page: a row click opens its own side drawer (event details + JSON diff), and nothing in the drawer opens the row's record page. "Open as list" goes to the object list, not to a row. So from the place an administrator actually reads the ledger, the "other changes to the same record" list is not reachable; the administrator still sees a digest and no value.

## Expected

- The drawer offers a way to open the selected audit row's record page (the generic record route for `sys_audit_log` / that row's id), at least for a row that carries a `record_id`.
- Or, if the ui lane prefers, the drawer itself lists the other rows with the same `record_id` (the same read the page's related list makes, through the data API, so the ledger's read gate and redaction apply unchanged).
- A pin: on a `config_change` row the drawer reaches the mirror's update row for the same settings row.

Related: #30209 (the Setup readability card; rows 1 and 5 B still open there).
